name: Do I need a permit for cast iron drain pipe repair or replacement in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for cast iron drain pipe repair or replacement in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for significant cast iron drain pipe repair or replacement projects in Las Vegas, including any work that involves altering the main drain lines or extensive excavation, a plumbing permit is typically required by local building codes. This ensures the work meets safety and quality standards. Minor repairs, such as fixing a small leak on an exposed pipe, may not require a permit. CG Plumbing Solutions manages all necessary permitting processes for your project to ensure compliance with local regulations in Las Vegas and surrounding areas.
